#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const int mod = 1e9 + 7;
int p, k, ans, vis[1 << 20];
int solve() {
	ans = 1;
	if(!k)
  {
    for(int i=1;i<p;++i)ans=1LL*ans*p%mod;
  }
	else if(k == 1) {
		for(int i = 1; i <= p; ++ i) {
			ans = 1LL * ans * p % mod;
		}
	} else {
		for(int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
			if(!vis[i]) {
				int len = 0;
				while(!vis[i]) {
					vis[i] = 1;
					++len;
					i = 1LL * i * k % p;
				}
				if(i != 0)
				ans = 1LL * ans * p % mod;
			}
		}
	}
	return ans;
}
int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("data", "r", stdin);
#endif

	cin >> p >> k;
	cout << solve();

}
</perturbed_code_1>
